content: Elzabeelippe Eelaasi Betda Bete
Eelaasi ooththida ooso ubbaa, Ba7aale nabetakka giththa mashshan izi wostti wodhisidaakko Akaabey Elzabeelis yootides.

Histtiin Elzabeela, «Neni he nabeta bolla ooththoyssaththo tanikka ne shemppo wonto hanni wode iziththo ooththontta aggiko xoossati hessafekka aadhdhiza iita ta bolla gaththetto» gaada qasttanne Eelaasas yeddadus.
Histtiin Eelaasi babbidi ba shemppo ashshanaas Yuhuda biittan diza Bersaabehe gakkanaas betides; ba ashkaraakka heen aggides.
Issi gallassa oge bazzon hemettides. Bishe sankkara miththa kuwa garsan uttidi, «Abeet GODAWU! Taas gidana; tani ta aawatappe aadhdhike. Ta shemppoyo ne ekka» giidi hayqo amotti woossides.
Hessafe guye sankkara kuwan ichchidi dhiskides; izi heen dhiskon dishin issi kiitanchchay iza bochchidi, «Dendada hayssa ma» gides.
Histtiin dendidi izi xeelliza wode seelan uukettida kompanne otora diza haath ba hu7esoppe demmides; izappe mi uyidaappe guyen simmi dhiskides.
GODAA kiitanchchay nam7anththoka yi Eelaasa beegoththidi, «Neni baanaasoy haaho gidida gishshas dendada ma» gides.
Histtiin Eelaasi dendidi midessinne uyides. Eelaasi kaththaa mi minnidi Xoossa zuma Korebe gakkanaas oyddu tammu gallassinne oyddu tammu omars hemettides.
Heen diza gongolo giddo gelidi aqides. Eelaasas Godaa Qoncceth GODAA qaalay izakko yiidi, «Eelaasaa! Hayssan ay ooththay?» gides.

Histtiin Eelaasi, «Ubbaafe Wolqqama GODAA Xoossaas tani keeha zil7ettadis; gaasoykka Isra7eele asay nenara caaqettida caaqoza menththides; nees yarsho yarshizasohotakka laallides; ne nabetakka giththa mashshan wodhides; tani tarkka attadis shin ha7i tanakka wodhana koyeettes» gides.

GODAY izas, «Hessafe keza baada zumaa xeeran ta sinththan eqqa; GODAY heera aadhdhana» gides. Hessafe guye wolqqama carkoy zumata phalqereththides; zaallatakka kinchchereththi yeggides; GODAY gidikko he carkoza giddon deenna. He carkozappe simmiin biittay qaaxxides; GODAY he biitta qaaththaankka deenna.
Biitta qaaththaafe simmiin tamay kezides; gido attiin GODAY tamaa giddon deenna. Tamaappe simmiin saasukeththa cenggurssi siyettides.
Eelaasi hessa siyidi ba may7ida hashe may7on ba ayfeso kammides. Histtidi kare kezi gongoloza pengen eqqides. Hessafe guye, «Eelaasaa! Hayssan ay ooththay?» giza cenggurs siyides.

Eelaasi zaaridi, «Ubbaafe Wolqqama GODAA Xoossaas tani keeha zil7ettadis; gaasoykka Isra7eele asay nenara caaqettida caaqoza menththides; nees yarsho yarshizasohotakka laallides; ne nabetakka giththa mashshan wodhides; tani tarkka attadis shin ha7i tanakka wodhana koyeettes» gides.
Histtiin GODAY Eelaasas zaaridi, «Ne kase yida ogezara simmada Damasqo bazzo ba. Hee ba gakkada Azaheeley Aaraame bolla kawotana mala iza tiya.
Qasseka Nimishe naa Iyu Isra7eele bolla kawotana mala tiya. Hessaththoka ne sohon nabe gidana mala Aabeeli-Mahoole dere as Saafaaxe naa Elssa7e tiya.
Azaheele mashshafe kessi ekki attidayssa Iyuy wodhana; qasse Iyu mashshafe kessi ekki attidayssa Elssa7i wodhana.
Ba7aales gulbatonttaytanne ba doonan Ba7aale geetettiza eeqa misleza yeerontta attida 7,000 as tani Isra7eelen taas ashshana» gides.
Elssa7e Xeygeteth

Eelaasi heeppe dendi bishin Saafaaxe naa Elssa7i tammanne nam7u waaxa booran goyishin demmides; tammanne nam7anththa waaxa booratan Elssa7i goyees. Eelaasi izakko shiiqidi ba hashe may7o iza bolla yeggides.

Elssa7i boorata aggidi Eelaasakko woxxi biidi, «Tani ta aawaanne ta aayo saro gaada moysetta simmada ta nena kaallana mala tana yeddarkkii!» gides. Histtiin Eelaasi Elssa7e, «Baada ya! Ta nena ayde diggadinaa?» gides.

Hessa gishshas Elssa7i aggi guye simmidi nam7u boorata shukkides; boora miishshata qeridi izan ashoza doyssides; he kaxxida ashoza deraas aaththiin asay mides. Hessafe guye dendi biidi Eelaasa kaallidessinne Eelaasa maaddides.

footnotes.text: Zil7ettadis gizayssa issi issi bagga gamoththo qaalan mishettadis, qanaatadis geettes.
